proof_explanation: The proof is reflexivity. By implementing negate(value) as Bool.not(value), both sides of the equality negate(value) == Bool.not(value) are definitionally identical, making the proof trivial. The empty proof term {} represents this reflexive equality.

seeded_attack.reason: The implementation fails to implement Boolean negation. The negate function returns its input value unchanged instead of applying Bool.not, which violates the law requiring negate(value) == Bool.not(value) for all Bool values.
